title: Range of a Fourier observation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Then $f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i\in[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the Boolean cube to signs
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
